messages:
maria: Heads-up — final RN draft for v2.14 is in the doc. Plan: internal announce at 15:00 PT, pin model versions, deploy window 16:00-17:00 PT. Need quick sign-offs and rollback criteria.

sam: quick skim looks good. what's the pin list? and rollback SLOs?

deploybot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2024-05-03 16:00–17:00 PT. To pin versions run:
```
/deploy pin --service inference-api --model redwood-llm-v2.14 --route prod
/deploy pin --service emb-server --version embed-v4
```
Current canary route: prod-canary (5%).

evan: Rollback thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p50 latency increase > 30% over baseline for 5m. If triggered, we'll automatic-fallback to redwood-llm-v2.13 and abort canary. Agree?

kate: canary audience is small cohort (internal + beta). Recommend we hold the announce until canary passes 30m health checks. Also suggest adding a known-issues bullet about tokenization change.

sam: +1 to waiting 30m. Also add a short RN line about slight prompt tuning.

maria: ok locking plan: will send internal announce at 14:50 PT to ops & dev leads but will include a note: 'announce to broader team after canary 30m pass'. Pin commands will be run at 16:00 by @sam. deploybot window already set. I'll paste RN snippet in channel before sending.

sam: I'll be on standby for pin and rollback. ping me oncall if anything odd :phone: 
deploybot: Reminder: to cancel window use `/deploy cancel-window 1715559999` within the next 2h.

maria: thanks team — final RN snippet below, pls reply asap if concerns:

'v2.14: performance and stability improvements; pinning as redwood-llm-v2.14; canary rollouts with automatic fallback to v2.13. See internal docs for more.' :white_check_mark:

kate: Looks fine. +1

evan: +1

sam: green to go from me.

maria: sending internal announce in 5 — will update thread after canary start.
